main_text.p: [?]uis, clarus sub Carolo Magno, Nestorianæ hæreseos profligator: in Sacrosyllabo, & Libris contrà Felicem, Pauli nomine aliquoties Epistolam citat. Sic lib. i. adducturus locum Hebr. ii.14. Sic Libro ii. itidem locum Hebr. i.4. Apostolus in Epistola ad Hebræos &c.

XLVII. Haymo, ex monacho Halberstadensis in Saxoniâ Episcopus, membrum Synodi Moguntinæ in Gottefchal-chum congregatæ, medio fere nono sæculo: quid de Epistola statuerit, suo prodidit in eam Commentario, ubi Paulinis annumerat, & Paulo vindicat comportatis argumentis, iisdem quæ supra in Pri-masio.

XLVIII. Rabanus Maurus, Archiepiscopus Moguntinus, Gottefchalci adversarius, oralis manducationis & corporalis præsentiæ cum Johanne Erigena acerrimus impugnator; de instit. Cleric. L. ii. C. LIV. Hos (sc. Evangeliorum & Actorum libros) quatuordecim Pauli Apostoli Epistolæ sequuntur. Annectuntur tamen illa ipsa verba, quæ supra notavimus

page.notes: The first word of the page is cut off by a dark stain; only the final letters are legible, so the start is marked [?]. The Hebrew citation numbers ("ii.14", "i.4") and "Libro ii." are read as printed in roman numerals and may be partly unclear. The catchword "in" and the signature "I" are at the foot of the page.
